name: Volume Price Trend
description: This keyword returns the value of the Volume Price Trend of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword.
how_to_use_markdown:
This keyword returns the value of the Volume Price Trend of the selected Instrument. This keyword is to be used under the position keyword.

![Example](./images/img-1632223885.png)

You can plot  Volume Price Trend  on any candle of an instrument, like in the above example, you can also plot  Volume Price Trend  of previous (-1) day candle of Nifty Financial Services futures.
